proof_scope: Tau Python workspace kernel receipt and lifecycle coverage

claims.proves: the declared Tau Python workspace positive and adversarial kernel receipt checks pass across repeated trials using the real project test runner and optional Jupyter kernel profile
claims.does_not_prove: full Tau issue #323 production rollout, kernel sandboxing, host-call bridge behavior, provider/model quality, or every operating-system process-loss mode

cases.name: python-workspace-live-kernel-regression
command: cd .. && uv run --extra python-workspace pytest tests/test_python_kernel_backend.py -q

cases.name: python-kernel-worker-entrypoint-canary
command: cd .. && out=$(mktemp -d /tmp/tau-kernel-worker-eval-XXXXXX) && uv run --extra python-workspace tau-python-kernel-worker --canary-output-dir "$out"

cases.name: adversarial-kernel-contract-and-lifecycle-boundaries
command: cd .. && uv run --extra python-workspace pytest tests/test_python_kernel_backend.py -q -k 'unknown_capability or binding_mutation or import_failure or interrupt or unrelated_reused_pid'
